card: This PR disables wide-character support, zoneinfo, and generic clocale in Guix cross-compiled libstdc++ for non-GUI Linux targets, keeping wchar_t enabled only for GUI targets. It also disables the libstdc++ experimental filesystem TS library and patches Boost Test in depends to build without std::wcrtomb. The change reduces the size of non-GUI release binaries like bitcoind and bitcoin-cli by roughly 0.5 MB. It is based on and includes PR #36531.
changed_since_previous: Incorporated the commit from #36531 into the branch, switching `contrib/guix/guix-build` from `GUIX_PACKAGE_PATH` to passing `--load-path` directly to `guix shell`.
evidence: PR description benchmarks show binary size savings of roughly 0.48 MB across non-GUI binaries (e.g. bitcoind from 17.75 MB to 17.27 MB, bitcoin-cli from 8.20 MB to 7.72 MB).
problem: Release Linux binaries include unused libstdc++ features such as wide-character support, timezone information, and experimental filesystem routines, unnecessarily inflating non-GUI binary sizes.

risk.why: Altering libstdc++ configure flags for Guix cross-toolchains could introduce runtime errors in release binaries if unexpected C++ standard library features are stripped.

scope_notes: Includes a patch to Boost Test in depends and incorporates changes from PR #36531 modifying `contrib/guix/guix-build`.
summary: Configures the Guix GCC cross-compiler toolchain for non-GUI Linux targets to build libstdc++ with `--disable-wchar_t`, `--enable-clocale=generic`, and `--with-libstdcxx-zoneinfo=no`, while disabling the experimental filesystem TS library across Linux toolchains. It preserves wchar_t support for GUI builds, patches Boost Test in depends to use unqualified `wcrtomb` so tests continue to build without standard wchar_t symbols, and switches Guix module loading to `--load-path`.
